title: Config
description:
User configuration. Every field is optional, so parents and children merge
field by field.

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at `schema.json`. Accepted and ignored.

Command.description:
Commands run after Amaca enters the worktree and before WezTerm and Claude
start.

created.description: Command run when the worktree was just created: a shell line or an argv.

Prompt.description: Prompts sent to Claude. `{id}` is replaced with the ticket id.

created.description: Prompt used when the worktree was just created.

existing.description: Prompt used when the worktree already existed.

Run.description: A configured command: a shell line, or an argv run without a shell.

anyOf.description: Shell line, run through system(3). It cannot hold a NUL.
Argv run directly, without a shell. The first element is the program.
